assessed_claims.explanation: An official employer domain (nimbusinfotech.example) was resolved from independent results. This shows the employer exists; it does not show this letter came from it.
The sender uses a free webmail address, while the employer's careers page says recruitment email comes only from @nimbusinfotech.example.
The letter demands a payment to unlock joining. The employer's published policy says it never charges candidates.
No public listing for this role was found. Roles can be unlisted or expired, so this is neither support nor a warning.
